Data Protection

Data Protection Notice (KVKK)

Information on personal data processed through the contact form, under Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698.

Contents

1. Data controller2. Personal data processed3. Purposes of processing4. Legal grounds and method of collection5. Transfer of personal data6. Retention period7. Your rights8. How to submit a request

Last updated: 12 November 2026

1. Data controller

This notice has been prepared by Kerim Kahraman | Healthcare Consulting (Bursa, Türkiye), as data controller, pursuant to Article 10 of Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (“KVKK”).

2. Personal data processed

The following data is processed through the contact form:

  • Identity: full name
  • Contact details: email address, phone number (optional)
  • Professional details: company / organisation name, country (optional)
  • Enquiry details: service of interest and message content

The form does not request any special categories of personal data, including health data. Please do not share such data.

3. Purposes of processing

Your personal data is processed for the following purposes:

  • Receiving and reviewing your consulting enquiry
  • Contacting you and answering your questions
  • Holding preliminary discussions about a possible collaboration
  • Complying with legal obligations

4. Legal grounds and method of collection

Your personal data is collected electronically through the contact form on the website and processed on the legal grounds set out in Article 5(2) of the KVKK: where processing is directly related to the conclusion or performance of a contract (sub-paragraph c), and where it is necessary for the legitimate interests of the data controller, provided that your fundamental rights and freedoms are not harmed (sub-paragraph f).

5. Transfer of personal data

Your personal data is never sold or shared for marketing purposes. It may be shared, limited to the purposes of processing, only with service providers used for website hosting, form delivery and email services, and with legally authorised public authorities upon request. Where service providers’ servers are located outside Türkiye, any transfer is carried out in accordance with the conditions set out in Article 9 of the KVKK.

6. Retention period

Your personal data is retained for as long as necessary to review your enquiry and to establish a possible business relationship. If no business relationship is established, the data is deleted, destroyed or anonymised within one year at the latest after your enquiry has been concluded, unless a longer period is required by law.

7. Your rights

Under Article 11 of the KVKK, you have the right to apply to the data controller to:

  • learn whether your personal data is processed;
  • request information if it has been processed;
  • learn the purpose of processing and whether it is used in line with that purpose;
  • know the third parties to whom it is transferred in Türkiye or abroad;
  • request correction if it is incomplete or inaccurate;
  • request erasure or destruction under the conditions set out in the KVKK;
  • request that third parties to whom the data was transferred be notified of such correction, erasure or destruction;
  • object to any outcome against you resulting from analysis exclusively by automated systems;
  • claim compensation for damages arising from unlawful processing.

8. How to submit a request

You can submit requests regarding your rights in writing, together with information that verifies your identity, via the channels on our Contact page. Requests are concluded free of charge within thirty days at the latest, depending on their nature.
